game_title: The Lost Legacy of C · Ritchie and Bell Labs
game_concept: A action defense set in Shadow Cave – Crystal Grotto, a grotto of glowing crystals: the spelunker must handle rock golems while practicing control flow: while loops. Core idea – Nested While Dungeon: Run an inner loop for each room inside an outer loop for each floor.
theme: Shadow Cave – Crystal Grotto: a grotto of glowing crystals
core_gameplay_loop: Search the archive, examine recovered computing artifacts, and use their evidence to verify the assigned C lesson.
player_objective: Case 10: Find 5 artifacts, read the evidence, and verify three findings about Ritchie and Bell Labs.
controls: Select objects in the room. Review discovered objects in Evidence and verify your findings. Tab and Enter select controls. Escape closes a card or pauses.
win_condition: Recover all 5 artifacts and answer all three evidence checks correctly.
lose_condition: The case ends when the available incorrect evidence checks are exhausted.
learning_alignment: CP1 Week 4: Ritchie and Bell Labs
assets_style: Shared archive artwork, illustrated artifacts, and Kenney interface audio.
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Nested While Dungeon' (Week 4 slot 15), mission type 'Survival Siege', and setting 'Crystal Grotto'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.
topic: Introduction to C: History, Characteristics and Classification

region.name: Shadow Cave
region.mood: echoing drips, low drones and torch crackle

tutorial: Match the silhouettes in the tray to the objects in the room.
Inspect each artifact to read its history.
Open Evidence to review the records and verify your findings.
source_player_objective: Protect the wooden door from rock golems in Crystal Grotto: keep the dungeon_clear meter above zero by applying the concept correctly until the 26-second timer ends.
source_lose_condition: dungeon_clear drops to 0, or lives reach 0, before the 26-second timer ends.
source_game_title: Nested While Dungeon – Crystal Grotto Defense
hint: Match an unfound object in the tray to its shape in the room. The Evidence folder keeps every record you uncover.
